_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, so a later edit to scene.narration can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

open.text: There is no signal. How long do you boil creek water?

first-launch.text: On first launch the library is empty, and the panel says so plainly.

field-library.text: Copy reference documents into the sources volume. Ingestion indexes them.

library-shelf.text: The whole shelf stays browsable offline, on hardware you own.

type-a-question.text: Type any question in plain language; nothing leaves the device to answer it.

ask-a-question.text: Ask a question. Retrieval finds the passages, and a model on this device answers.

check-the-sources.text: See exactly which documents the answer came from. Verify before you act.

no-model-no-panic.text: With no language model installed it says so, and the library stays browsable.

recap.text: Your documents, your questions, your answers. It keeps working when the network does not.

close.text: Just In Case, from Companion Intelligence. UnCloud your life.

no-network.text: The network is gone and nothing changes. The encyclopedia is on the box too.
